DELL ACCELERATOR WORKSHOP FOR GENERATIVE AI

The Accelerator Workshop is a starting point to determining how your business will achieve maximized benefits from GenAI.

What is an Accelerator Workshop? Our half day facilitated workshop discussions draw on our experience working with thousands of other organizations. We focus on the activities required to achieve your desired end state and conclude with next steps to further advance your business and IT strategies.

Take the first step in your GenAI journey Dell experts, working together with your team, will help you begin to develop a point of view on important GenAI questions and create a vision for your future state. Utilizing our “AS-IS” / “TO-BE” methodology, we will conduct interviews and review the existing environment to identify challenges and opportunities and drive consensus for GenAI, synthesized in an Executive Overview.
